name: Local assets
description: Generate assets locally through services on this Mac — Qwen3-TTS voice (:8799) and ComfyUI image (:8188). No Genex account, no credits, nothing leaves the machine. Drama 3 is also on :8799 once a reference voice file is configured.

tools.name: voice
tools.description: Generate a local voice line and save it to the project. Defaults to Qwen3-TTS (no reference needed). Switch model to drama-3 once a reference voice file is configured. Returns the saved file path.

model.description: TTS engine on :8799: qwen3-tts (default) or drama-3.

file.description: Output file name inside the project, e.g. voice-01.mp3.
